title: git commit fails inside Codex's workspace-write sandbox because .git is read-only
symptoms: git commit, git checkout, or git stash fail with a permission error inside Codex
Git writes worked on Linux before a Codex update and fail now
cause: workspace-write keeps .git, a worktree's resolved gitdir, .agents, .codex, and .aws read-only even inside writable roots. Linux was brought in line with macOS, so git metadata writes that once worked there are now blocked.
fix: Let Codex edit files and run git yourself, approve an escalation for the git command, or use danger-full-access only in an isolated environment.
apply: codex --sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval on-request   # approve the escalated git command when asked
affected: Codex CLI workspace-write sandbox on macOS and Linux, as of 2026-10
